summary: Tested live public routes, authentication, contact, gallery lightbox, admin dashboard/content views, and core API CRUD.

critical.issue: Logout only deletes the cookie; an existing Authorization bearer access_token remains valid and can still access /api/dashboard after logout.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /admin/media produces a blank screen; expected admin-media-grid or admin-media-empty-state never renders despite GET /api/media returning 200 [].

action_items: Invalidate or revoke bearer tokens on logout, or ensure server-side session invalidation consistent with logout semantics.
Fix AdminMedia rendering crash/blank state and retest upload/delete flows.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminMedia has no catch handler for its initial GET /media failure; API errors can leave an indistinguishable blank/loading screen.
Auth uses stateless JWTs with no revocation mechanism, so logout cannot invalidate bearer tokens.

success_rate.backend: 50% (1/2 pytest scenarios; logout bearer invalidation failed)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST service; created one contact submission via the public flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public /, /about, /services, /projects, project detail, /gallery, /contact passed. Gallery lightbox open/close and contact success passed. Invalid and valid login/dashboard passed. Admin services/projects/gallery/settings route loads passed. Media route blank despite API 200 []. Mobile and logout browser checks were not reached after media failure.
rca of the issue: API verification: authenticated GET /api/media returns 200 []. UI reproduction: login, visit /admin/media, wait 8 seconds; page remains blank and neither admin-media-grid nor admin-media-empty-state is present. Inspect browser console/React runtime error to identify component crash. Logout reproduction: login with bearer token, POST /api/auth/logout, then GET /api/dashboard with same Authorization header returns 200; cookie deletion does not revoke JWT.
